dogecoin.text: Premise: In the dark underworld of cryptocurrencies, Dogecoin, Shiba Inu, and Pepe find themselves trapped in a nightmare when CRASH emerges.

Characters:   Dogecoin, Shiba Inu, Pepe, CRASH
Dogecoin is a wise-cracking, optimistic meme coin who tries to keep the group together.
Shiba Inu is a fierce and determined fighter, always ready to take on any challenge.
